articles.title: Steve Rosenberg: Russia's economic forum overshadowed by drone attacks on St Petersburg
articles.description: The BBC's Russia editor saw Putin's flagship economic event overshadowed by Ukrainian drones attacks.

articles.title: North Korea will never surrender nuclear status, Kim Jong Un's sister says
articles.description: The powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has declared that the country will never surrender its nuclear-armed status and continue to expand its atomic arsenal.

articles.title: Hegseth uses D-Day speech to issue immigration warning
articles.description: Pete Hegseth has warned Europe is facing "an invasion of dangerous ideologies" arriving by sea, as he linked immigration to the legacy of the D-Day landings in Normandy.
